- Strategic fit: Pivotal is an emerging payer-tech customer in the Midwest with high potential ARR ($200k+/yr) if pilot converts.
- Technical fit: they require model routing and prefix caching — capabilities we can operationalize cleanly and show strong latency wins.
- Risk: pilot volume is modest; financial exposure limited to the one-time credit and standard support hours.

1) Approve one-time onboarding credit of $9,000 applied to invoice 1 (no recurring discount).
2) Approve bundling Compact Bundle for pilot SKU (no long-term price change; future rate card to be evaluated on renewal).

Attachments: pricing-model-ph-pilot.xlsx (shows unit economics and break-even).

If you want, I can add product + solutions notes (estimated integration 10–15 engineer-hours, billed as professional services if >8 hours).
